description: This file contains a PHP library for date and time manipulation, supporting extended date ranges beyond native PHP functions, including conversions, formatting, leap year calculations, and Gregorian calendar corrections.

methods.name: adodb_getdate
methods.description: Returns an array with detailed date information supporting extended date ranges.

methods.name: adodb_date
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a date string with support for extended date ranges.

methods.name: adodb_date2
methods.description: Formats a date string or timestamp into a date string, accepting ISO date format.

methods.name: adodb_gmdate
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a GMT date string supporting extended date ranges.

methods.name: adodb_mktime
methods.description: Converts local date components into a Unix timestamp supporting dates outside the 1901-2038 range.

methods.name: adodb_gmmktime
methods.description: Converts GMT date components into a Unix timestamp supporting extended date ranges.

methods.name: adodb_gmstrftime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a GMT date string with extended range support.

methods.name: adodb_strftime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a localized date string with support for extended date ranges.

methods.name: adodb_get_gmt_diff
methods.description: Returns the local timezone offset from GMT.

methods.name: adodb_dow
methods.description: Calculates the day of the week for a given date.

methods.name: _adodb_is_leap_year
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year, considering Julian and Gregorian calendars.

methods.name: adodb_year_digit_check
methods.description: Converts 2-digit years to 4-digit years, assuming century based on proximity.
